content.summary: The next bounded task repairs the retained invalid signed-argument response using the exact frozen source, candidate set and validator diagnostics. Mechanical validity of its attacks is the acceptance criterion; neither acceptance nor the source-fidelity labels resolve the legal interpretation.
findings: All four candidates must have arguments and every quote must resolve to the retained source. Signed attacks must satisfy their declared structural preconditions.

The prior response mixed strict and defeasible attacks and used invalid attack targets. The frozen request carries those errors into a focused repair rather than asking for an unrelated replacement verdict.
Maximum three counted calls, 180 seconds each and cumulative new-grant reservation ceiling 169. A persistent failure remains explicit and cannot be marked as a valid argument graph.

The source-fidelity matrix concerns encoded coverage, not legal truth. Misleading output labels and unimplemented case-dependent classifications remain successor repair items regardless of argument acceptance.
Same-model correlation, missing statutory authority, ordinary-course modality and interpretation completeness remain unmeasured. A valid graph cannot confer release authority.
